method.note: Whole-file numbers include the wave's symbol items. Inside the workset's range the only line never run is the trampoline's NULL-handle branch (release_hooks, hwcontext.rs:1928): hwdevice_ctx_free always passes the live context, so it is unreachable. hwcontext.c stays at 78.04% of 428 lines on both trees.
